description: Hall-map interchange schema v2 = hall_map_schema_v1 (inherited unchanged, sha256-bound below) plus wall-adjacent quantities that HallThruster.jl v0.23.1 at the pinned commit GENUINELY computes. Every added field names the exact solver variable/function it comes from, its units, whether it is per cell or aggregated, and whether it is a solver-computed state or a configuration input. Quantities the solver does not compute are listed under not_supplied and are NOT fields. No added field has a producer yet (status 'not_computed'): emitting them needs a bridge/driver change, which is a controlled model-pipeline change needing owner approval (see migration). A point missing a not_computed field is not v2-map-ready and a field must never be filled with a placeholder (same rule as v1).

milestones.A: not needed for conditional selection (no absolute Hall number is required); this file states which wall quantities a future admitted-member map can and cannot deliver
milestones.B: not on the Milestone B critical path (B needs thrust / eta_u / P_d / I_d from admitted-member maps, which v1 already defines)
milestones.C: supports the PDR wall-life and thermal closure: wall-adjacent T_e, effective SEE yield, sheath potential and species-resolved wall ion flux are the model-side counterparts of docs/evidence/wall_life/ H7 (near-wall diagnostics) and H9 (SEE yield). To reach C: an admitted member (credible set empty today), the owner-approved producer change, ion_wall_losses decision (docs/hallmap/HALLMAP_PRODUCTION_SPEC.md open decision 3), a cited sputter-yield model with incidence-angle treatment from a source other than this solver

inherits.rule: Every v1 meta key, convention and field is carried into v2 with the identical definition. hall_map_schema_v1.json stays unchanged and historically valid; v1 maps remain v1 maps (they are never relabelled v2). A v2 map's meta.schema is 'hall_map_schema_v2'. abep_sim/hall_map.py is NOT modified by this lane and therefore loads v1 maps only; a v2 consumer is a separate, later change.

solver_basis.identity_check: git tree hash of the installed copy recomputed in this lane = 7505b3a2a6cfeb6854801de53c6985443aeb8363 = hallthruster_bridge/Manifest.toml [[deps.HallThruster]] git-tree-sha1, recorded by Pkg with repo-rev bfb3019fc74ceaa2c70c9d3b19236a83a44ee3b5 and version 0.23.1

bridge_read.function: wall_ion_metrics(sol, config, i0) (v1 producer of wall_ion_flux_m2s / wall_ion_energy_eV); read only

solver_basis.saved_frame_fact: HallThruster.Frame (src/simulation/solution.jl) saves per frame: per-species ion and neutral n, nu, u, m, Z (SpeciesState), Tev, ne, nu_wall (= cache.νew_momentum), B, potential, channel_area, tan_div_angle and other profiles. It does NOT save cache.γ_SEE, cache.m_eff, cache.wall_transition, cache.radial_loss_frequency or cache.wall_losses. The Solution keeps config (hence wall_loss_model, thruster.shielded, transition_length, ion_wall_losses) but not the run cache.

evaluation_rule: Every added quantity is re-evaluated by the producer in EVERY saved frame of the averaging window (never on the time-averaged state; breathing makes the two differ), with the solver's OWN functions (HallThruster.SEE_yield, HallThruster.sheath_potential, HallThruster.edge_to_center_density_ratio, HallThruster.linear_transition) applied to the solver's own saved per-frame state and the run's own Config. This is the same method, and the same limitation, as the v1 wall fields: the values are what the solver's model computes, re-evaluated from saved state, not copied from a solver output array (the solver does not save them). Nothing is derived from unrelated global diagnostics (thrust, efficiencies, divergence angle, discharge current).
channel_cells_rule: Aggregated channel quantities use the SAME cell set as v1 wall_ion_flux_m2s (grid cells with z <= channel_length; unweighted mean over cells, then mean over frames) so that v1 and v2 aggregates are directly comparable. The profile fields additionally carry profile_wall_transition so a consumer can reproduce the solver's own footprint (see finding F2 in docs/hallmap/schema_v2/HALLMAP_SCHEMA_V2.md).

wall_loss_model.definition: Config.wall_loss_model as run: model type name (WallSheath required for every added wall field), material name, material epsilon_star_eV and sigma0, and loss_scale (WallSheath.loss_scale). String or object as the producer writes it; must be copied from the run's Config, never retyped
wall_loss_model.solver_source: src/physics/wall_losses.jl: struct WallMaterial(name, ϵ_star, σ₀); struct WallSheath(material, loss_scale); Config keyword default WallSheath(BNSiO2, 1.0) (src/simulation/configuration.jl)

shielded.definition: Config.thruster.shielded (bool). Every added wall field is produced only for shielded = false (see not_supplied NS-7)
shielded.solver_source: src/thruster/thruster.jl field shielded::Bool = false; used by wall_electron_temperature (src/physics/wall_losses.jl)

transition_length_m.definition: Config.transition_length as run; sets wall_transition(z) = linear_transition(z, channel_length, transition_length, 1, 0) (src/simulation/plume.jl initialize_plume_geometry)

electron_plume_loss_scale.definition: Config.electron_plume_loss_scale as run (scales electron wall power loss outside the channel; src/physics/wall_losses.jl wall_power_loss!)

wall_fields_basis.definition: producer statement, like v1 wall_ion_basis: 'WallSheath, unshielded, re-evaluated per saved frame with the solver's own functions' or the reason the wall fields are absent

wall_Te_eV.aggregation: Bohm-ion-flux-weighted mean over channel cells (channel_cells_rule) and over the saved frames of the averaging window, weights = the per-cell total Bohm ion flux of wall_ion_flux_m2s
wall_Te_eV.solver_variable: HallThruster.wall_electron_temperature(params, i) (src/physics/wall_losses.jl), which returns cache.Tev[i] when thruster.shielded = false; saved per frame as Frame.Tev (= copy_and_remove_ghosts(cache.Tev))
wall_Te_eV.definition: electron temperature the WallSheath model uses at the wall of cell i (for the SEE yield, the sheath potential and the Bohm flux). In the 1-D model this is the local channel-centre T_e, not a separately resolved near-wall T_e; the solver has no radial resolution (see not_supplied NS-6)

wall_see_yield_eff.aggregation: Bohm-ion-flux-weighted mean over channel cells and frames (as wall_Te_eV)
wall_see_yield_eff.kind: solver-computed state (re-evaluated; not saved by the solver)
wall_see_yield_eff.solver_variable: cache.γ_SEE[i], set in freq_electron_wall!(νew, ::WallSheath, params) as SEE_yield(model.material, Tev_wall, γ_SEE_max) with γ_SEE_max = 1 - 8.3 * sqrt(me / cache.m_eff[i]) (src/physics/wall_losses.jl). Re-evaluated per frame as HallThruster.SEE_yield(config.wall_loss_model.material, Frame.Tev[i], 1 - 8.3*sqrt(HallThruster.me/m_eff_i)), m_eff_i = sum_s n_s m_s / sum_s n_s over Frame.ions (the solver's number-averaged ion mass, src/simulation/heavy_species_update.jl update_heavy_species_cache!)
wall_see_yield_eff.definition: effective (space-charge-limited) secondary-electron-emission yield of the WallSheath model: min(γ_max, σ₀ + 1.5 T_e/ϵ* (1 - σ₀)). Electron-induced SEE as a function of T_e only; material constants are the model inputs in meta.wall_loss_model

wall_see_space_charge_limited_fraction.aggregation: Bohm-ion-flux-weighted fraction of channel cell-frames in which SEE_yield returned the cap γ_SEE_max
wall_see_space_charge_limited_fraction.definition: tells whether the effective yield is set by the material fit or by the space-charge cap; needed to interpret wall_see_yield_eff against measured SEE yields (docs/evidence/wall_life/ H9)

wall_sheath_potential_V.aggregation: Bohm-ion-flux-weighted mean over channel cells and frames
wall_sheath_potential_V.solver_variable: HallThruster.sheath_potential(Tev, γ, m_eff) = Tev * log((1 - γ) * sqrt(m_eff / π / me / 2)) (src/physics/wall_losses.jl; positive by convention), as used in wall_power_loss!(Q, ::WallSheath, params) and in the v1 wall_ion_energy_eV
wall_sheath_potential_V.definition: space-charge-limited sheath potential of the WallSheath model (one sheath per cell for the ion mixture, number-averaged ion mass)

wall_ion_flux_fraction_atomic.aggregation: share of the channel-mean total Bohm ion number flux (v1 wall_ion_flux_m2s) carried by ion species whose parent formula is a single atom (same natoms rule as v1 ion_species_fraction_atomic)
wall_ion_flux_fraction_atomic.solver_variable: per species s: loss_scale * edge_to_center_density_ratio() * n_s * sqrt(Z_s e T_e / m_s) with n_s, Z_s, m_s from Frame.ions (the Bohm flux of freq_electron_wall! / apply_ion_wall_losses!, src/physics/wall_losses.jl, src/simulation/heavy_species_update.jl)
wall_ion_flux_fraction_atomic.definition: species split of the wall ion flux; for Xe = 1 by definition

wall_ion_flux_fraction_multiply_charged.aggregation: share of the channel-mean total Bohm ion number flux carried by species with Z >= 2
wall_ion_flux_fraction_multiply_charged.definition: multiply charged ions hit the wall with Z * phi_s + T_e/2 (sheath energy scales with Z)

wall_ion_species.level: raw record (per node; not interpolated by a map consumer)
wall_ion_species.aggregation: one entry per ion species in Frame.ions (propellant key, charge Z, mass m_kg): channel-mean Bohm number flux flux_m2s [m^-2 s^-1] (v1 definition restricted to the species), flux_fraction [-], flux-weighted mean impact energy impact_energy_eV = Z phi_s + T_e/2 [eV] (sheath + Bohm presheath; excludes axial ion kinetic energy, as v1)
wall_ion_species.solver_variable: Frame.ions[propellant][k]::SpeciesState (n, m, Z), Frame.Tev, HallThruster.sheath_potential, HallThruster.edge_to_center_density_ratio, WallSheath.loss_scale
wall_ion_species.definition: wall-impact ION species information. Only ions reach the wall in the solver (negative ions are skipped, src/simulation/heavy_species_update.jl apply_ion_wall_losses!); neutrals, excited states and fast neutrals have no wall-impact model (not_supplied NS-3)

profile_wall_transition.type: float array over the saved grid
profile_wall_transition.solver_variable: cache.wall_transition[i] = linear_transition(cell_centers[i], channel_length, transition_length, 1.0, 0.0) (src/simulation/plume.jl initialize_plume_geometry; src/utilities/smoothing.jl). Not saved in Frame; reproduced with HallThruster.linear_transition on Solution.grid
profile_wall_transition.definition: the solver's inside-channel indicator (1 inside, linear ramp over transition_length centred on the exit, 0 outside); it weights the electron wall momentum collisions and, with ion_wall_losses = true, the ion wall removal

profile_wall_Te_eV.type: float array over the saved grid
profile_wall_Te_eV.aggregation: per cell, mean over the saved frames of the averaging window

profile_wall_see_yield.type: float array over the saved grid
profile_wall_see_yield.aggregation: per cell, mean over frames of the per-frame re-evaluated yield

profile_wall_sheath_potential_V.type: float array over the saved grid

profile_wall_ion_flux_m2s_by_species.type: object: species label -> float array over the saved grid
profile_wall_ion_flux_m2s_by_species.definition: per-cell, per-species Bohm wall ion flux (not weighted by wall_transition; multiply by profile_wall_transition to obtain the solver's ion-removal footprint)

profile_ion_wall_removal_m3s_by_species.type: object: species label -> float array over the saved grid
profile_ion_wall_removal_m3s_by_species.solver_variable: density_loss / m_s in apply_ion_wall_losses!(fluid_containers, wall_loss_base, wall_cells): n_s * νiw with νiw = wall_transition[i] * sqrt(e Tev[i]) * h * wall_loss_scale / (outer_radius - inner_radius) * sqrt(Z_s / m_s), cells 2:last_wall_cell (src/simulation/heavy_species_update.jl prepare_ion_wall_losses!, apply_ion_wall_losses!)
profile_ion_wall_removal_m3s_by_species.definition: volumetric ion removal rate the solver applies to the ion fluid (and returns to the ground-state neutral of the same fluid container). Physically applied only when Config.ion_wall_losses = true; with false the producer must write it as absent (not zero) and state that in wall_fields_basis

NS-1_incidence_angle.quantity: ion (or neutral) incidence angle at the wall, mean or distribution
NS-1_incidence_angle.why_not: The solver is 1-D axial (z). The wall ion flux is a radial Bohm-flux closure with no radial velocity, no r-z geometry of the channel wall and no angular information. Frame.tan_div_angle (cache.tanδ, src/simulation/plume.jl) is the PLUME divergence used for the plume area expansion, not a wall incidence angle, and must not be used as one (it would be a derivation from an unrelated diagnostic)
NS-1_incidence_angle.would_need: an r-z (2-D) or kinetic sheath/erosion model, or measured near-wall ion angle distributions (docs/evidence/wall_life/ H7) or a published, cited angle treatment for the wall grade (docs/evidence/wall_life/ flag ANGLE_OUTSIDE_MEASURED)

NS-2_ion_energy_distribution.quantity: ion impact energy distribution at the wall (beyond the mean Z phi_s + T_e/2), and the axial kinetic-energy contribution
NS-2_ion_energy_distribution.why_not: fluid model with one isothermal ion velocity per species; no wall IEDF, no oblique-impact kinetic energy
NS-2_ion_energy_distribution.would_need: kinetic/PIC or 2-D model, or RPA/flush-probe measurements (wall_life H7)

NS-3_neutral_and_excited_wall_impact.quantity: neutral, fast charge-exchange neutral and excited-state fluxes/energies to the wall; wall quenching of excited states
NS-3_neutral_and_excited_wall_impact.why_not: the solver has no neutral or excited-state wall flux; neutrals only gain density from ion recombination at the wall (apply_ion_wall_losses!, neutral_fluid = ground_neutral(fluid_containers)); no wall term in src/simulation/deexcitation.jl
NS-3_neutral_and_excited_wall_impact.would_need: a neutral wall-flux model (e.g. free-molecular wall flux with a CEX source) added to the solver, i.e. a model change

NS-4_wall_recombination_products.quantity: species returned by the wall (e.g. N + N -> N2 recombination, dissociative neutralisation of N2+)
NS-4_wall_recombination_products.why_not: fixed rule only: each recombined ion is returned as the ground-state neutral (first continuity fluid) of the same fluid container; no wall chemistry. The grouping of N/N2 species into containers for the project N2 reaction set is not re-verified here: verify
NS-4_wall_recombination_products.would_need: a cited wall-chemistry model and a solver change

NS-5_inner_outer_wall_split.quantity: separate inner- and outer-wall fluxes, T_e, SEE, sheath potential
NS-5_inner_outer_wall_split.why_not: single channel width Δr = outer_radius - inner_radius; the model has no inner/outer distinction

NS-6_resolved_near_wall_Te.quantity: a near-wall electron temperature distinct from the channel-centre T_e (radial T_e profile, anisotropy, depleted-tail EEDF)
NS-6_resolved_near_wall_Te.why_not: wall_electron_temperature returns the 1-D cell T_e for unshielded thrusters; no radial profile or EEDF
NS-6_resolved_near_wall_Te.would_need: r-z or kinetic model, or near-wall probe data (wall_life H7)

NS-7_shielded_wall_fields.quantity: all added wall fields for a magnetically shielded thruster
NS-7_shielded_wall_fields.why_not: for shielded = true, wall_electron_temperature uses cache.Tev[1] (ghost cell) blended with the local T_e by cache.wall_transition; Frame.Tev[1] is the ghost-averaged edge value 0.5*(Tev[1]+Tev[2]) (copy_and_remove_ghosts), so the solver's wall T_e is not reproducible from saved frames (same reason as bridge_lib.jl wall_ion_metrics: 'wall T_e needs solver cache not saved in frames')
NS-7_shielded_wall_fields.would_need: the solver to save cache.γ_SEE and the wall T_e (upstream/pin change) or an owner-approved bridge hook reading the cache during the run; and a schema change for shielded designs (HALLMAP_PRODUCTION_SPEC open decision 4)

NS-8_ion_induced_SEE_and_SEE_spectrum.quantity: ion-induced SEE, SEE energy spectrum, electron backscatter, SEE change with N/O exposure
NS-8_ion_induced_SEE_and_SEE_spectrum.why_not: SEE_yield is an electron-induced fit in T_e with two material constants; no other emission channel
NS-8_ion_induced_SEE_and_SEE_spectrum.would_need: a cited SEE model and wall_life H9 measurements

NS-9_wall_temperature_sputtering_erosion.quantity: wall surface temperature, sputter yield, erosion rate, wall-profile evolution
NS-9_wall_temperature_sputtering_erosion.would_need: abep_sim/thermal_life.py wall heat + erosion chain with a cited sputter-yield model (docs/evidence/wall_life/)

NS-10_frame_resolved_solver_arrays.quantity: the solver's own cache.γ_SEE / cache.m_eff / cache.wall_losses arrays as saved outputs
NS-10_frame_resolved_solver_arrays.why_not: not in HallThruster.Frame; the added fields are therefore re-evaluations (evaluation_rule), not copies
NS-10_frame_resolved_solver_arrays.would_need: an upstream Frame extension and a pin move (never automatic; PINNED.toml upgrade_policy)

migration.statement: Emitting any v2 field requires changes to hallthruster_bridge/bridge_lib.jl (wall_ion_metrics or a new wall_v2_metrics), the driver that writes records/maps, a v2-aware consumer (hall_map.py or a successor) and a consistency check like hallthruster_bridge/checks/wall_flux_consistency.jl. That is a controlled model-pipeline change and needs owner approval. It is NOT done in this lane: no bridge, driver, campaign, prereg, pinned-pipeline file or running job is touched, and hall_map.py still loads v1 only.
migration.compatibility: v1 maps stay valid v1 maps. A v2 map carries every v1 field unchanged, so a v2 record can be checked against v1 by dropping the added keys. v1 and v2 maps are never mixed inside one map set.
migration.consistency_check_proposed: PROPOSED for the owner: the producer change ships a check that, per channel cell-frame where wall_transition = 1, the re-evaluated sum_s Z_s Gamma_s / (Δr (1 - γ) ne) reproduces the solver-saved Frame.nu_wall (the same identity checks/wall_flux_consistency.jl uses for Z = 1 xenon, extended to mixtures and to the re-evaluated γ). The acceptance tolerance is an owner decision; the existing check uses a 1 % median (that value is the existing check's, not a new proposal).
migration.not_a_validation: All v2 fields are model-derived outputs of an unadmitted-or-admitted closure; they are not validated against wall measurements (none exist). They inherit every v1 trust rule: wall fields are erosion-grade only when wall_life_trustworthy.
